T: Bowls up. Tonight there's plenty to go round.

P: Serve the roast chicken when the workhouse board sit down to their feast while the boys queue for gruel.
S: fat pork links on buttered toast with sticky onions and brown sauce, consider yourself at home
Fat pork sausages fried in the pan the way Fagin cooks them for the boys, on buttered toast with slow sticky onions and brown sauce.
homemade, full of holes, cooked in rings, soaked with butter and golden syrup, Who Will Buy
Homemade English crumpets, full of holes, cooked in rings on the stove and soaked with butter and golden syrup, the breakfast of a boy who has never had one.
M: Workhouse governors' roast chicken and bread sauce
golden bird with lemon and thyme, crisp potatoes, peas and clove milk sauce, board members only
The feast the workhouse board keep for themselves: golden roast chicken with lemon and thyme, crisp roast potatoes and carrots, peas and a proper clove-scented bread sauce.
Nancy leading Oom-Pah-Pah round the tables at the Three Cripples

Beef and onion pies in shortcrust with mash and green parsley liquor. Toss the beef in 1 tbsp of the flour and brown in the oil. Add the sliced onions for 5 minutes. Add the stock and Worcestershire, cover and simmer for 1 and a half hours until tender and thick. Cool. Line four pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Boil the peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with half the butter and a splash of the milk. Melt the rest of the butter, stir in the rest of the flour, whisk in the rest of the milk and simmer for 3 minutes, then blend with the parsley and vinegar for the liquor. Serve each pie with a scoop of mash and the liquor poured over.
W: creamy vanilla oats over stewed apple, burnt sugar crust, you will ask for more
A grand joke on gruel: creamy vanilla oat pudding with stewed apples and cinnamon, set in bowls and burnt under a crackling sugar crust.
K: To warm the boys in the den on a foggy London night
A Victorian street corner warmer: fresh ginger, lemon and honey simmered into a cordial and topped up with hot water and apple juice, served in mugs.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the sticky onions up to 3 days ahead and keep them in the fridge; fry the sausages and toast on the night

steps.text: Cook the onions slowly in 1 tbsp of the oil with the salt for 20 minutes until soft and golden, then stir in the brown sugar and vinegar and cook 5 minutes more until sticky.
Fry the sausages in the rest of the oil in another pan over medium heat, turning, until browned and cooked through.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Pile the onions and sausages on the toast and serve with brown sauce.

steps.text: Cook the onions slowly in 1 tbsp of the oil with the salt for 20 minutes until soft and golden, then stir in the brown sugar and vinegar and cook 5 minutes more until sticky.
Fry the vegetarian sausages in the rest of the oil in another pan, turning, until browned all over.

dishes.make_ahead: Cook the crumpets up to 2 days ahead, cool and keep airtight, then toast them to order

steps.text: Warm the milk with 100ml water, whisk in the yeast and 1 tsp of the sugar and leave until frothy.
Beat into the flour and salt to a thick, smooth batter, cover and leave until bubbly.
Whisk in the bicarb soda dissolved in 2 tbsp warm water.
Grease 4 egg rings and a heavy pan with a little of the butter and cook the batter in the rings over low to medium heat until set and full of holes, then flip briefly. Repeat.
Mix the rest of the sugar with the cinnamon and serve the crumpets hot with butter, golden syrup and cinnamon sugar.

dishes.n: Workhouse governors' roast chicken and bread sauce
dishes.make_ahead: Infuse the milk for the bread sauce up to 1 day ahead; roast and finish the sauce on the night

ingredients.item: small brown onion, halved and studded with 4 cloves

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub the chicken with the butter and half the salt and pepper, push the lemon and thyme into the cavity and sit it in a roasting dish.
Roast the chicken, adding the potatoes and carrots tossed with the oil and the rest of the salt and pepper for the last hour.
Warm the milk with the studded onion and bay leaf, leave to infuse 20 minutes, then remove them and stir in the breadcrumbs and nutmeg. Simmer gently until thick.
Rest the chicken 15 minutes, cook the peas and serve with the vegetables and bread sauce.

veg.n: Workhouse governors' roast cauliflower and bread sauce
veg.make_ahead: Infuse the milk for the bread sauce up to 1 day ahead; roast and finish the sauce on the night

ingredients.item: small brown onion, halved and studded with 4 cloves

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub the whole cauliflower with the butter, lemon juice, thyme leaves and half the salt and pepper and sit it in a roasting dish.

Toss the potatoes and carrots with the oil and the rest of the salt and pepper and roast with the cauliflower for 60 minutes, basting the cauliflower with its butter twice, until it is soft right through and browned.
Warm the milk with the studded onion and bay leaf, leave to infuse 20 minutes, then remove them and stir in the breadcrumbs and nutmeg. Simmer gently until thick.
Cook the peas and serve the cauliflower in wedges with the roast potatoes, carrots, peas and bread sauce.

veg.n: Three Cripples cheese and onion pie and mash
veg.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 2 days ahead and chill; fill and bake on the night

steps.text: Boil the diced filling potatoes for 10 minutes. Fry the sliced onions in 20g of the butter until soft.
Mix with the cheddar and mustard and cool.
Line four pie tins with shortcrust, fill, top with puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes.
Boil the rest of the peeled potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 30g of the butter and a splash of the milk.
Melt the rest of the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the rest of the milk and simmer for 3 minutes, then blend with the parsley and vinegar for the liquor.
Serve each pie with a scoop of mash and the liquor poured over.

dishes.make_ahead: Stew the apples up to 2 days ahead; cook the oats and burn the sugar on the night

steps.text: Simmer the apples with the brown sugar, cinnamon and 2 tbsp water until soft and split between 4 heatproof bowls.
Simmer the oats with the milk, cream, sugar, vanilla and salt, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Spoon over the apples, smooth the tops and leave to set.
Scatter the caster sugar over the tops and burn with a blowtorch or under a very hot grill until glassy.

dishes.make_ahead: Make and strain the ginger cordial up to 5 days ahead and keep it in the fridge; heat with the apple juice to order

steps.text: Simmer the ginger, lemon peel and juice, honey, cinnamon and 300ml water, then strain.
Heat the apple juice until steaming and stir in the ginger cordial.
Pour into 4 mugs and add a slice of lemon.

s.note: Pan-fried pork sausages on buttered toast with slow-cooked sticky onions and brown sauce
s.how: Cook 3 thinly sliced brown onions slowly in 1 tbsp oil with a pinch of salt for 20 minutes until soft and golden, then stir in 1 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp malt vinegar and cook 5 minutes more until sticky. Fry 8 thick pork sausages in another pan in 1 tbsp oil over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through. Toast 4 thick slices of crusty bread, butter them, pile on the onions and sausages and serve with brown sauce.

s.note: Homemade griddled crumpets with salted butter, golden syrup and a sprinkle of cinnamon sugar
s.how: Warm 300ml milk and 100ml water to blood heat, whisk in 7g dried yeast and 1 tsp sugar and leave 10 minutes. Beat into 300g plain flour with 1 tsp salt to a thick, smooth batter, cover and leave 1 hour until bubbly. Whisk in 1/2 tsp bicarb soda dissolved in 2 tbsp warm water. Heat a heavy pan over low to medium heat, grease 4 egg rings and the pan with butter, fill the rings halfway and cook 8 minutes until the tops are set and full of holes. Lift off the rings, flip for 1 minute and repeat. Serve hot with butter, golden syrup and cinnamon sugar.

m.n: Workhouse governors' roast chicken and bread sauce
m.note: Lemon and thyme roast chicken with roast potatoes and carrots, peas and a creamy clove and nutmeg bread sauce
m.how: Heat the oven to 200C. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 60g softened butter, salt and pepper, push half a lemon and thyme into the cavity and roast for 1 1/2 hours until the juices run clear, then rest 15 minutes. Toss 1kg halved potatoes and 500g carrots with 3 tbsp oil, salt and pepper and roast alongside for the last hour. Warm 500ml milk with an onion studded with 4 cloves and a bay leaf, infuse 20 minutes, remove them, then stir in 100g fresh breadcrumbs and nutmeg and simmer gently until thick. Cook 300g peas and serve everything together.

w.note: Creamy vanilla and cinnamon oat pudding over stewed apples, with a crackling burnt sugar top
w.how: Peel and dice 3 apples and simmer with 2 tbsp brown sugar, a pinch of cinnamon and 2 tbsp water for 8 minutes until soft, then split between 4 heatproof bowls. Simmer 100g rolled oats with 600ml milk, 150ml cream, 2 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp vanilla and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy. Spoon over the apples, smooth the tops and leave to set for 20 minutes. Scatter 1 tbsp caster sugar over each and burn with a blowtorch or under a very hot grill until glassy.

d.note: Fresh ginger, lemon, honey and cinnamon simmered into a cordial, lengthened with hot apple juice, in mugs
d.how: Simmer a 6cm piece of sliced ginger, the peel and juice of 2 lemons, 80g honey, 1 cinnamon stick and 300ml water for 10 minutes, then strain. Heat 1 litre apple juice until steaming, stir in the ginger cordial and pour into 4 mugs with a slice of lemon.
